title: cqtna: Context-Specific QTL Target Nomination Audit
description: An audit for candidate lists produced by cis-eQTL-instrumented Mendelian randomization. Runs the automatable part of eight diagnostics on a candidate list and reports what kind of evidence each nominated gene carries: locus attribution against the outcome's own known loci with a mismatched-list negative control, the same list recomputed over four inference units, stability against a second outcome GWAS, instrument attrition at three separate levels, compartment attribution, eQTL-to-GWAS peak distance, and a sweep of the two window conventions a fold enrichment depends on. Three of the eight diagnostics cannot be automated from a candidate list and are named in every report rather than omitted. Also reports whether single-linkage clustering has chained distinct regions into one block, and provides a density-matched permutation control. No gene reaches target-supported from this tool, by design. This is a research companion to one study, not a validated general-purpose platform.
